WHERE item.tag IS NOT NULL
  AND any(label IN labels(item) WHERE label IN [
    'AngleBallValve', 'AngleGlobeValve', 'AnglePlugValve', 'AngleValve',
    'BallValve', 'BreatherValve', 'ButterflyValve', 'CheckValve',
    'GateValve', 'GlobeCheckValve', 'GlobeValve', 'NeedleValve',
    'OperatedValve', 'PlugValve', 'SafetyValveOrFitting',
    'SpringLoadedAngleGlobeSafetyValve', 'SpringLoadedGlobeSafetyValve',
    'StraightwayValve', 'SwingCheckValve'
  ])
RETURN item.tag AS tag
ORDER BY tag;

MATCH p = (source:PlantItem)-[:send_to*1..]->(equipment:Equipment {tag: "M-2301"})
WITH p, reverse(nodes(p)) AS upstream_to_equipment
WITH head([
  v IN upstream_to_equipment
  WHERE any(label IN labels(v) WHERE label IN [
    "GateValve", "BallValve", "AngleBallValve", "GlobeValve", "AngleGlobeValve",
    "PlugValve", "AnglePlugValve", "AngleValve", "ButterflyValve", "NeedleValve"
  ])
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (:PlantItem)-[:control]->(v) }
  | v
]) AS valve
WHERE valve IS NOT NULL AND valve.tag IS NOT NULL
RETURN DISTINCT valve.tag AS tag
